questions.question: How long has it been feeling this way?
questions.subtext: Honest answers help us match the right psychologist.

options.label: A few weeks
A few months
Over six months
It's been most of my life

questions.question: Which of these feel most true right now?

options.label: It's hard to start anything, even small things
I'm pulling away from people
I've lost interest in things I used to love
I feel empty or numb more than sad
I'm tired no matter how much I sleep

questions.question: How are mornings feeling?
questions.subtext: First thing when you wake up.

options.label: I dread getting out of bed
I'm okay once I get going, but starting is hard
Mornings are fine — it hits later in the day
It's pretty constant from morning to night

questions.question: Which of these sounds most like the voice in your head?

options.label: "I'm letting everyone down"
"What's even the point?"
"I should be able to handle this"
"I just feel… nothing"

questions.question: Have you tried anything for this before?
questions.subtext: Whatever the answer is, it's okay.

options.label: No, this is my first step
Books, apps, journalling
Therapy or counselling in the past
I'm on medication or in therapy now

questions.question: How ready do you feel to actually work on this?
questions.subtext: It's fine if the answer is 'not very' — we'll start gently.

questions.question: What would feel different if things were better?
questions.subtext: There's no right answer — pick what resonates.

options.label: I'd want to do things again — even small ones
I'd feel like myself when I look in the mirror
I'd reach out to people instead of hiding
I'd stop running on empty all the time
